abilities.name: Ceremonial Bladework
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

abilities.name: Frostgnaw
abilities.canon: Unleashes a frigid blast, dealing Cryo DMG to opponents in front of Kaeya.

abilities.name: Glacial Waltz
abilities.canon:
Coalescing the frost in the air, Kaeya summons 3 icicles that revolve around him.
These icicles will follow the character around and deal Cryo DMG to opponents in their path for the ability's duration.

abilities.name: Cold-Blooded Strike
abilities.canon: Every hit with Frostgnaw regenerates HP for Kaeya equal to 15% of his ATK.

abilities.name: Glacial Heart
abilities.canon:
Opponents Frozen by Frostgnaw will drop additional Elemental Particles.
Frostgnaw may only produce a maximum of 2 additional Elemental Particles per use.

abilities.name: Hidden Strength
abilities.canon:
Decreases sprinting Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.

abilities.name: Excellent Blood
abilities.canon: The CRIT Rate of Kaeya's Normal and Charge Attacks against opponents affected by Cryo is increased by 15%.

abilities.name: Never-Ending Performance
abilities.canon: While Glacial Waltz is in effect, for each opponent defeated, its duration is increased by 2.5s, up to a maximum of 15s.

abilities.name: Dance of Frost
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Frostgnaw by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

abilities.name: Frozen Kiss
abilities.canon:
Triggers automatically when Kaeya's HP falls below 20%:
Creates a shield that absorbs damage equal to 30% of Kaeya's Max HP. Lasts for 20s.
This shield absorbs Cryo DMG with 250% efficiency.
Can only occur once every 60s.

abilities.name: Frostbiting Embrace
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Glacial Waltz by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

abilities.name: Glacial Whirlwind
abilities.canon: Glacial Waltz will generate 1 additional icicle, and will regenerate 15 Energy when cast.
